=====================================================
 EXP-9 : ARCHITECTURE STUDY - TMS320C6748 (C674x core)
=====================================================
CSR register            = 0x14000100
  CPU ID                = 0x14
  Revision ID           = 0x00
  Endian (bit 8)        = LITTLE
  GIE  (global int en)  = 0
sizeof(char/short/int/long/float/double) = 1/2/4/4/4/8 bytes

--- 64-tap dot product (MAC) benchmark ----------------
float  MAC loop  : result =   0.000000   cycles = 536
Q15    MAC loop  : result =          0   cycles = 536
SIMD  _dotp2     : result =          0   cycles = 280
SIMD speed-up over plain fixed loop = 1.91 x

--- Key architectural features -----------------------
Core            : C674x  = C64x+ (fixed) + C67x+ (float)
Architecture    : VLIW, 8 functional units .L .S .M .D x 2 paths
Register file   : 2 x 32 x 32-bit (A0-A31, B0-B31)
Pipeline        : 4 fetch + 2 decode + up to 10 execute phases
Memory          : Harvard, L1P 32KB, L1D 32KB, L2 256KB, 128KB shRAM
Max clock       : 456 MHz  (3648 MMACS / 2746 MFLOPS)
Addressing      : linear, circular (AMR), bit-reversed (for FFT)
Peripherals     : McASP, McBSP, EDMA3, UART, SPI, I2C, uPP, EMIFA/DDR2
=====================================================
@@ labsim: note: TSCL/TSCH give an estimated cycle count (4 cycles per C statement), not the C674x's real timing.
@@ labsim: exit 0
